events.title: Edison & Ford Holiday Nights
events.priceLabel: $23 adults, $13 teens, $3 ages 6–12; 5 and under free
events.blurb: The 51st annual Holiday Nights opens at the winter homes of Thomas Edison and Henry Ford, glowing with thousands of lights and historic decorations. Opening night Friday includes a tree lighting at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Abre la 51.ª edición de Holiday Nights en las casas de invierno de Thomas Edison y Henry Ford, con miles de luces y decoraciones históricas. La noche de apertura del viernes incluye el encendido del árbol a las 6 p.m.
events.getThere: Free parking; arrive early for the best availability.

events.title: A Magical Motown Christmas
events.venue: Barbara B. Mann Performing Arts Hall
events.blurb: A holiday concert of Motown hits from the Temptations, the Jackson Five, the Supremes, Marvin Gaye, Stevie Wonder and Smokey Robinson.
events.blurbEs: Un concierto navideño con éxitos de Motown de los Temptations, los Jackson Five, las Supremes, Marvin Gaye, Stevie Wonder y Smokey Robinson.

events.title: The Rock Orchestra by Candlelight
events.venue: Barbara B. Mann Performing Arts Hall
events.blurb: A 14-member classical ensemble plays rock and metal hits by Metallica, AC/DC, Guns N' Roses and Linkin Park in a candlelit 90-minute show.
events.blurbEs: Un conjunto clásico de 14 músicos interpreta éxitos de rock y metal de Metallica, AC/DC, Guns N' Roses y Linkin Park en un espectáculo de 90 minutos a la luz de las velas.

events.title: A.J. Croce Presents Croce Plays Croce
events.venue: Barbara B. Mann Performing Arts Hall
events.blurb: A.J. Croce mixes his father Jim Croce's songs, like "Operator" and "Time in a Bottle," with his own music and stories.
events.blurbEs: A.J. Croce combina canciones de su padre Jim Croce, como "Operator" y "Time in a Bottle", con su propia música e historias.

events.title: FGCU Women's Basketball vs. Tennessee
events.addr: FGCU Lake Pkwy E, Fort Myers, FL 33965
events.blurb: The FGCU Eagles host the Tennessee Lady Vols on Black Friday night at Alico Arena.
events.blurbEs: Las FGCU Eagles reciben a las Tennessee Lady Vols la noche del Black Friday en el Alico Arena.

events.title: Guided Boardwalk Walk at Six Mile Cypress Slough
events.blurb: A free 45-minute guided walk along the preserve's 1.2-mile boardwalk through a cypress wetland, held on the fourth Saturday. Registration opens 30 minutes before at the Trail Host Station; groups are limited to 10 per guide.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo guiado gratis de 45 minutos por la pasarela de 1.2 millas del humedal de cipreses, el cuarto sábado del mes. La inscripción abre 30 minutos antes en la Trail Host Station; grupos de máximo 10 personas por guía.
events.getThere: Parking is $1 per hour per vehicle ($5 daily max); Lee County annual parking passes are accepted.
